NKJV.1: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine woven linen and blue, purple, and scarlet thread; with artistic designs of cherubim you shall weave them.
NKJV.2: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. And every one of the curtains shall have the same measurements.
NKJV.3: Five curtains shall be coupled to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.
NKJV.4: And you shall make loops of blue yarn on the edge of the curtain on the selvedge of one set, and likewise you shall do on the outer edge of the other curtain of the second set.
NKJV.5: Fifty loops you shall make in the one curtain, and fifty loops you shall make on the edge of the curtain that is on the end of the second set, that the loops may be clasped to one another.
NKJV.6: And you shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains together with the clasps, so that it may be one tabernacle.
NKJV.7: “You shall also make curtains of goats’ hair, to be a tent over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.
NKJV.8: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; and the eleven curtains shall all have the same measurements.
NKJV.9: And you shall couple five curtains by themselves and six curtains by themselves, and you shall double over the sixth curtain at the forefront of the tent.
NKJV.10: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in one set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain of the second set.
NKJV.11: And you shall make fifty bronze clasps, put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
NKJV.12: The remnant that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
NKJV.13: And a cubit on one side and a cubit on the other side, of what remains of the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle, on this side and on that side, to cover it.
NKJV.14: “You shall also make a covering of ram skins dyed red for the tent, and a covering of badger skins above that.
NKJV.15: “And for the tabernacle you shall make the boards of acacia wood, standing upright.
NKJV.16: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the width of each board.
NKJV.17: Two tenons shall be in each board for binding one to another. Thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
NKJV.18: And you shall make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side.
NKJV.19: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under each of the boards for its two tenons.
NKJV.20: And for the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, there shall be twenty boards
NKJV.21: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under each of the boards.
NKJV.22: For the far side of the tabernacle, westward, you shall make six boards.
NKJV.23: And you shall also make two boards for the two back corners of the tabernacle.
NKJV.24: They shall be coupled together at the bottom and they shall be coupled together at the top by one ring. Thus it shall be for both of them. They shall be for the two corners.
NKJV.25: So there shall be eight boards with their sockets of silver—sixteen sockets—two sockets under each of the boards.
NKJV.26: “And you shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards on one side of the tabernacle,
NKJV.27: five bars for the boards on the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.
NKJV.28: The middle bar shall pass through the midst of the boards from end to end.
NKJV.29: You shall overlay the boards with gold, make their rings of gold as holders for the bars, and overlay the bars with gold.
NKJV.30: And you shall raise up the tabernacle according to its pattern which you were shown on the mountain.
NKJV.31: “You shall make a veil woven of blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine woven linen. It shall be woven with an artistic design of cherubim.
NKJV.32: You shall hang it upon the four pillars of acacia wood overlaid with gold. Their hooks shall be gold, upon four sockets of silver.
NKJV.33: And you shall hang the veil from the clasps. Then you shall bring the ark of the Testimony in there, behind the veil. The veil shall be a divider for you between the holy place and the Most Holy.
NKJV.34: You shall put the mercy seat upon the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy.
NKJV.35: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand across from the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south; and you shall put the table on the north side.
NKJV.36: “You shall make a screen for the door of the tabernacle, woven of blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine woven linen, made by a weaver.
NKJV.37: And you shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold; their hooks shall be gold, and you shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.

NASB.1: 'Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twisted linen and blue and purple and scarlet [material]; you shall make them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.
NASB.2: 'The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; all the curtains shall have the same measurements.
NASB.3: 'Five curtains shall be joined to one another, and [the other] five curtains [shall be] joined to one another.
NASB.4: 'You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the outermost curtain in the [first] set, and likewise you shall make [them] on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second set.
NASB.5: 'You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is in the second set; the loops shall be opposite each other.
NASB.6: 'You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and join the curtains to one another with the clasps so that the tabernacle will be a unit.
NASB.7: 'Then you shall make curtains of goats' [hair] for a tent over the tabernacle; you shall make eleven curtains in all.
NASB.8: 'The length of each curtain [shall be] thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; the eleven curtains shall have the same measurements.
NASB.9: 'You shall join five curtains by themselves and the [other] six curtains by themselves, and you shall double over the sixth curtain at the front of the tent.
NASB.10: 'You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the [first] set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain [that is outermost in] the second set.
NASB.11: 'You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and you shall put the clasps into the loops and join the tent together so that it will be a unit.
NASB.12: 'The overlapping part that is left over in the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that is left over, shall lap over the back of the tabernacle.
NASB.13: 'The cubit on one side and the cubit on the other, of what is left over in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall lap over the sides of the tabernacle on one side and on the other, to cover it.
NASB.14: 'You shall make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red and a covering of porpoise skins above.
NASB.15: 'Then you shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
NASB.16: 'Ten cubits [shall be] the length of each board and one and a half cubits the width of each board.
NASB.17: '[There] [shall be] two tenons for each board, fitted to one another; thus you shall do for all the boards of the tabernacle.
NASB.18: 'You shall make the boards for the tabernacle: twenty boards for the south side.
NASB.19: 'You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards, two sockets under one board for its two tenons and two sockets under another board for its two tenons;
NASB.20: and for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,
NASB.21: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board and two sockets under another board.
NASB.22: 'For the rear of the tabernacle, to the west, you shall make six boards.
NASB.23: 'You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle at the rear.
NASB.24: 'They shall be double beneath, and together they shall be complete to its top to the first ring; thus it shall be with both of them: they shall form the two corners.
NASB.25: 'There shall be eight boards with their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board and two sockets under another board.
NASB.26: 'Then you shall make bars of acacia wood, five for the boards of one side of the tabernacle,
NASB.27: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle for the rear [side] to the west.
NASB.28: 'The middle bar in the center of the boards shall pass through from end to end.
NASB.29: 'You shall overlay the boards with gold and make their rings of gold [as] holders for the bars; and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
NASB.30: 'Then you shall erect the tabernacle according to its plan which you have been shown in the mountain.
NASB.31: 'You shall make a veil of blue and purple and scarlet [material] and fine twisted linen; it shall be made with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.
NASB.32: 'You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold, their hooks [also being of] gold, on four sockets of silver.
NASB.33: 'You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring in the ark of the testimony there within the veil; and the veil shall serve for you as a partition between the holy place and the holy of holies.
NASB.34: 'You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the testimony in the holy of holies.
NASB.35: 'You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south; and you shall put the table on the north side.
NASB.36: 'You shall make a screen for the doorway of the tent of blue and purple and scarlet [material] and fine twisted linen, the work of a weaver.
NASB.37: 'You shall make five pillars of acacia for the screen and overlay them with gold, their hooks [also being of] gold; and you shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.

ESV.1: “Moreover, you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen and blue and purple and scarlet yarns; you shall make them with cherubim skillfully worked into them.
ESV.2: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits,  and the breadth of each curtain four cubits; all the curtains shall be the same size.
ESV.3: Five curtains shall be coupled to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.
ESV.4: And you shall make loops of blue on the edge of the outermost curtain in the first set. Likewise you shall make loops on the edge of the outermost curtain in the second set.
ESV.5: Fifty loops you shall make on the one curtain, and fifty loops you shall make on the edge of the curtain that is in the second set; the loops shall be opposite one another.
ESV.6: And you shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains one to the other with the clasps, so that the tabernacle may be a single whole.
ESV.7: “You shall also make curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains shall you make.
ESV.8: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits. The eleven curtains shall be the same size.
ESV.9: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and the sixth curtain you shall double over at the front of the tent.
ESV.10: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in one set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second set.
ESV.11: “You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together that it may be a single whole.
ESV.12: And the part that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
ESV.13: And the extra that remains in the length of the curtains, the cubit on the one side, and the cubit on the other side, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle, on this side and that side, to cover it.
ESV.14: And you shall make for the tent a covering of tanned rams' skins  and a covering of goatskins on top.
ESV.15: “You shall make upright frames for the tabernacle of acacia wood.
ESV.16: Ten cubits shall be the length of a frame, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each frame.
ESV.17: There shall be two tenons in each frame, for fitting together. So shall you do for all the frames of the tabernacle.
ESV.18: You shall make the frames for the tabernacle: twenty frames for the south side;
ESV.19: and forty bases of silver you shall make under the twenty frames, two bases under one frame for its two tenons, and two bases under the next frame for its two tenons;
ESV.20: and for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side twenty frames,
ESV.21: and their forty bases of silver, two bases under one frame, and two bases under the next frame.
ESV.22: And for the rear of the tabernacle westward you shall make six frames.
ESV.23: And you shall make two frames for corners of the tabernacle in the rear;
ESV.24: they shall be separate beneath, but joined at the top, at the first ring. Thus shall it be with both of them; they shall form the two corners.
ESV.25: And there shall be eight frames, with their bases of silver, sixteen bases; two bases under one frame, and two bases under another frame.
ESV.26: “You shall make bars of acacia wood, five for the frames of the one side of the tabernacle,
ESV.27: and five bars for the frames of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the frames of the side of the tabernacle at the rear westward.
ESV.28: The middle bar, halfway up the frames, shall run from end to end.
ESV.29: You shall overlay the frames with gold and shall make their rings of gold for holders for the bars, and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
ESV.30: Then you shall erect the tabernacle according to the plan for it that you were shown on the mountain.
ESV.31: “And you shall make a veil of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen. It shall be made with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
ESV.32: And you shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold, with hooks of gold, on four bases of silver.
ESV.33: And you shall hang the veil from the clasps, and bring the ark of the testimony in there within the veil. And the veil shall separate for you the Holy Place from the Most Holy.
ESV.34: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the testimony in the Most Holy Place.
ESV.35: And you shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand on the south side of the tabernacle opposite the table, and you shall put the table on the north side.
ESV.36: “You shall make a screen for the entrance of the tent, of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen, embroidered with needlework.
ESV.37: And you shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold, and you shall cast five bases of bronze for them.

CSB17.1: “You <sup>ⓕ</sup> are to construct the tabernacle itself with ten curtains. You must make them of finely spun linen, and blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, with a design of cherubim worked into them.
CSB17.2: Each curtain should be forty-two feet <sup>[1]</sup> long and six feet <sup>[2]</sup> wide; all the curtains are to have the same measurements.
CSB17.3: Five of the curtains should be joined together, and the other five curtains joined together.
CSB17.4: Make loops of blue yarn on the edge of the last curtain in the first set, and do the same on the edge of the outermost curtain in the second set.
CSB17.5: Make fifty loops on the one curtain and make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain in the second set, so that the loops line up together.
CSB17.6: Also make fifty gold clasps and join the curtains together with the clasps, so that the tabernacle may be a single unit.
CSB17.7: “You are to make curtains of goat hair for a tent over the tabernacle; make eleven of these curtains.
CSB17.8: Each curtain should be forty-five feet <sup>[3]</sup> long and six feet wide. All eleven curtains are to have the same measurements.
CSB17.9: Join five of the curtains by themselves, and the other six curtains by themselves. Then fold the sixth curtain double at the front of the tent.
CSB17.10: Make fifty loops on the edge of one curtain, the outermost in the first set, and make fifty loops on the edge of the corresponding curtain of the second set.
CSB17.11: Make fifty bronze clasps; put the clasps through the loops and join the tent together so that it is a single unit.
CSB17.12: As for the flap that remains from the tent curtains, the leftover half curtain is to hang over the back of the tabernacle.
CSB17.13: What remains along the length of the tent curtains — a half yard <sup>[4]</sup> on one side and a half yard on the other side — should hang over the sides of the tabernacle on either side to cover it.
CSB17.14: Make a covering for the tent from ram skins dyed red <sup>ⓖ</sup> and a covering of fine leather <sup>[5]</sup> on top of that.
CSB17.15: “You are to make upright supports <sup>[6]</sup> of acacia wood <sup>ⓗ</sup> for the tabernacle.
CSB17.16: Each support is to be fifteen feet <sup>[7]</sup> long and twenty-seven <sup>[8]</sup> inches wide.
CSB17.17: Each support will have two tenons for joining. Do the same for all the supports of the tabernacle.
CSB17.18: Make the supports for the tabernacle as follows: twenty supports for the south side,
CSB17.19: and make forty silver bases under the twenty supports, two bases under the first support for its two tenons, and two bases under the next support for its two tenons;
CSB17.20: twenty supports for the second side of the tabernacle, the north side,
CSB17.21: along with their forty silver bases, two bases under the first support and two bases under each support;
CSB17.22: and make six supports for the west side of the tabernacle.
CSB17.23: Make two additional supports for the two back corners of the tabernacle.
CSB17.24: They are to be paired at the bottom, and joined together <sup>[9]</sup> at the top in a single ring. So it should be for both of them; they will serve as the two corners.
CSB17.25: There are to be eight supports with their silver bases: sixteen bases; two bases under the first support and two bases under each support.
CSB17.26: “You are to make five crossbars of acacia wood for the supports on one side of the tabernacle,
CSB17.27: five crossbars for the supports on the other side of the tabernacle, and five crossbars for the supports of the back side of the tabernacle on the west.
CSB17.28: The central crossbar is to run through the middle of the supports from one end to the other.
CSB17.29: Then overlay the supports with gold, and make their rings of gold as the holders for the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.
CSB17.30: You are to set up the tabernacle according to the plan for it that you have been shown on the mountain. <sup>ⓘ</sup>
CSB17.31: “You are to make a curtain of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen with a design of cherubim worked into it. <sup>ⓙ</sup>
CSB17.32: Hang it on four gold-plated pillars of acacia wood that have gold hooks and that stand on four silver bases.
CSB17.33: Hang the curtain under the clasps <sup>[10]</sup> and bring the ark of the testimony there behind the curtain, so the curtain will make a separation for you between the holy place <sup>ⓚ</sup> and the most holy place.
CSB17.34: Put the mercy seat on the ark of the testimony in the most holy place. <sup>ⓛ</sup>
CSB17.35: Place the table outside the curtain and the lampstand on the south side of the tabernacle, opposite the table; put the table on the north side. <sup>ⓜ</sup>
CSB17.36: “For the entrance to the tent you are to make a screen embroidered <sup>[11]</sup> with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen.
CSB17.37: Make five pillars of acacia wood for the screen and overlay them with gold; their hooks are to be gold, and you are to cast five bronze bases for them.

AMP.1: "Moreover, you shall make the tabernacle (sacred tent of worship) with ten [interior] curtains of fine twisted linen, and blue, purple, and scarlet fabric; you shall make them with [embroidered] cherubim, the handwork of a skillful craftsman.
AMP.2: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; all of the curtains shall measure the same.
AMP.3: The five curtains shall be joined to one another, and the other five curtains shall be joined to one another.
AMP.4: You shall make loops of blue on the outer edge of the last curtain in the first set, and likewise in the second set.
AMP.5: You shall make fifty loops on the one curtain, and fifty loops on the edge of the last curtain that is in the second set. The loops on one curtain correspond to the loops on the other.
AMP.6: You shall make fifty gold hooks, and fasten the curtains together with the hooks; and the tabernacle shall be one unit.
AMP.7: "Then you shall make [exterior] curtains of goats' hair as a tent over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains in all.
AMP.8: Each curtain shall be thirty cubits long and four cubits wide. The eleven curtains shall all measure the same.
AMP.9: You shall join five curtains by themselves and the other six curtains by themselves, and you shall double over the sixth curtain at the front of the tent [to make a closed door].
AMP.10: Make fifty loops on the edge of the outermost curtain in the first set, and fifty loops on the edge of the outermost curtain in the second set.
AMP.11: "You shall make fifty bronze hooks and put the hooks into the loops and join the tent together so that it may be one unit.
AMP.12: The overlapping part that is left over from the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over, shall lap over the back of the tabernacle.
AMP.13: The cubit on one side and the cubit on the other, of what is left over in the length of the curtains of the tent shall lap over the sides of the tabernacle on one side and the other side, to cover it.
AMP.14: You shall make a third covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a fourth covering above that of porpoise skins.
AMP.15: "Then you shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright [as a trellis-like frame].
AMP.16: The length of each board shall be ten cubits and the width of each board shall be one and a half cubits.
AMP.17: Make two dovetails in each board for fitting [them] together; you shall do the same for all the tabernacle boards.
AMP.18: You shall make the boards for the tabernacle [in the following quantities]: twenty boards for the south side.
AMP.19: You shall make forty silver sockets under the twenty boards, two sockets under each board for its two dovetails, and two sockets under another board for its two dovetails;
AMP.20: for the north side of the tabernacle there shall be twenty boards,
AMP.21: and their forty silver sockets, two sockets under each board.
AMP.22: For the back or west side of the tabernacle you shall make six boards.
AMP.23: Make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle at the rear [on both sides].
AMP.24: They shall be joined together underneath, and joined together on top with one ring. So shall it be for both of them; they shall form the two [rear] corners.
AMP.25: There shall be eight boards and sixteen silver sockets; two sockets under each board.
AMP.26: "Then you shall make [fifteen] bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of one side of the tabernacle,
AMP.27: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the rear end of the tabernacle, for the back wall toward the west.
AMP.28: And the middle bar in the center of the boards shall pass through [horizontally] from end to end.
AMP.29: You shall overlay the boards with gold and make their rings of gold to hold the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.
AMP.30: You shall erect the tabernacle according to its plan [the direction corresponding to its meaning and purpose] which has been shown to you on the mountain.
AMP.31: "You shall make a veil [to divide the two rooms] of blue, purple, and scarlet fabric and fine twisted linen, skillfully worked with cherubim on it.
AMP.32: You shall hang it on four pillars (support poles) of acacia wood overlaid with gold, with gold hooks, on four silver sockets.
AMP.33: You shall hang the veil from the hooks [that connect the curtains together], and you shall bring the ark of the Testimony there within the veil. The veil shall separate for you the Holy Place and the Holy of Holies.
AMP.34: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony in the Holy of Holies.
AMP.35: You shall set the table [for the bread] outside the veil [in the Holy Place] on the north side, and the lampstand opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle.
AMP.36: "You shall make a screen [to provide a covering] for the doorway of the tent of blue, purple, and scarlet fabric and finely woven [embroidered] linen, the work of an embroiderer.
AMP.37: You shall make five pillars (support poles) of acacia wood to support the hanging curtain and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold, and you shall cast five [base] sockets of bronze for them.

WEB.1: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains; of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. The work of the skillful workman you shall make them.
WEB.2: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits,  and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.
WEB.3: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another; and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.
WEB.4: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling; and likewise you shall make in the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.
WEB.5: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite to one another.
WEB.6: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps: and the tabernacle shall be a unit.
WEB.7: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make them eleven curtains.
WEB.8: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.
WEB.9: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.
WEB.10: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.
WEB.11: You shall make fifty clasps of brass, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
WEB.12: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
WEB.13: The cubit on the one side, and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
WEB.14: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
WEB.15: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
WEB.16: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.
WEB.17: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
WEB.18: You shall make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.
WEB.19: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
WEB.20: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,
WEB.21: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
WEB.22: For the far part of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.
WEB.23: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.
WEB.24: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
WEB.25: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
WEB.26: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
WEB.27: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far part westward.
WEB.28: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.
WEB.29: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
WEB.30: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.
WEB.31: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. The work of the skillful workman shall it be made.
WEB.32: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.
WEB.33: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the testimony in there within the veil: and the veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.
WEB.34: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
WEB.35: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and you shall put the table on the north side.
WEB.36: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.
WEB.37: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold: their hooks shall be of gold: and you shall cast five sockets of brass for them.

NLT.1: “Make the Tabernacle from ten curtains of finely woven linen. Decorate the curtains with blue, purple, and scarlet thread and with skillfully embroidered cherubim.
NLT.2: These ten curtains must all be exactly the same size — 42 feet long and 6 feet wide.
NLT.3: Join five of these curtains together to make one long curtain, then join the other five into a second long curtain.
NLT.4: Put loops of blue yarn along the edge of the last curtain in each set.
NLT.5: The fifty loops along the edge of one curtain are to match the fifty loops along the edge of the other curtain.
NLT.6: Then make fifty gold clasps and fasten the long curtains together with the clasps. In this way, the Tabernacle will be made of one continuous piece.
NLT.7: “Make eleven curtains of goat-hair cloth to serve as a tent covering for the Tabernacle.
NLT.8: These eleven curtains must all be exactly the same size — 45 feet long and 6 feet wide.
NLT.9: Join five of these curtains together to make one long curtain, and join the other six into a second long curtain. Allow 3 feet of material from the second set of curtains to hang over the front of the sacred tent.
NLT.10: Make fifty loops for one edge of each large curtain.
NLT.11: Then make fifty bronze clasps, and fasten the loops of the long curtains with the clasps. In this way, the tent covering will be made of one continuous piece.
NLT.12: The remaining 3 feet of this tent covering will be left to hang over the back of the Tabernacle.
NLT.13: Allow 18 inches of remaining material to hang down over each side, so the Tabernacle is completely covered.
NLT.14: Complete the tent covering with a protective layer of tanned ram skins and a layer of fine goatskin leather.
NLT.15: “For the framework of the Tabernacle, construct frames of acacia wood.
NLT.16: Each frame must be 15 feet high and 27 inches wide,
NLT.17: with two pegs under each frame. Make all the frames identical.
NLT.18: Make twenty of these frames to support the curtains on the south side of the Tabernacle.
NLT.19: Also make forty silver bases — two bases under each frame, with the pegs fitting securely into the bases.
NLT.20: For the north side of the Tabernacle, make another twenty frames,
NLT.21: with their forty silver bases, two bases under each frame.
NLT.22: Make six frames for the rear — the west side of the Tabernacle —
NLT.23: along with two additional frames to reinforce the rear corners of the Tabernacle.
NLT.24: These corner frames will be matched at the bottom and firmly attached at the top with a single ring, forming a single corner unit. Make both of these corner units the same way.
NLT.25: So there will be eight frames at the rear of the Tabernacle, set in sixteen silver bases — two bases under each frame.
NLT.26: “Make crossbars of acacia wood to link the frames, five crossbars for the north side of the Tabernacle
NLT.27: and five for the south side. Also make five crossbars for the rear of the Tabernacle, which will face west.
NLT.28: The middle crossbar, attached halfway up the frames, will run all the way from one end of the Tabernacle to the other.
NLT.29: Overlay the frames with gold, and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Overlay the crossbars with gold as well.
NLT.30: “Set up this Tabernacle according to the pattern you were shown on the mountain.
NLT.31: “For the inside of the Tabernacle, make a special curtain of finely woven linen. Decorate it with blue, purple, and scarlet thread and with skillfully embroidered cherubim.
NLT.32: Hang this curtain on gold hooks attached to four posts of acacia wood. Overlay the posts with gold, and set them in four silver bases.
NLT.33: Hang the inner curtain from clasps, and put the Ark of the Covenant in the room behind it. This curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
NLT.34: “Then put the Ark’s cover — the place of atonement — on top of the Ark of the Covenant inside the Most Holy Place.
NLT.35: Place the table outside the inner curtain on the north side of the Tabernacle, and place the lampstand across the room on the south side.
NLT.36: “Make another curtain for the entrance to the sacred tent. Make it of finely woven linen and embroider it with exquisite designs, using blue, purple, and scarlet thread.
NLT.37: Craft five posts from acacia wood. Overlay them with gold, and hang the curtain from them with gold hooks. Cast five bronze bases for the posts.

NIV.1:
The Tabernacle
“Make the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim worked into them by a skilled craftsman.
NIV.2: All the curtains are to be the same size—twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.
NIV.3: Join five of the curtains together, and do the same with the other five.
NIV.4: Make loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and do the same with the end curtain in the other set.
NIV.5: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.
NIV.6: Then make fifty gold clasps and use them to fasten the curtains together so that the tabernacle is a unit.
NIV.7: “Make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven altogether.
NIV.8: All eleven curtains are to be the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
NIV.9: Join five of the curtains together into one set and the other six into another set. Fold the sixth curtain double at the front of the tent.
NIV.10: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.
NIV.11: Then make fifty bronze clasps and put them in the loops to fasten the tent together as a unit.
NIV.12: As for the additional length of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over is to hang down at the rear of the tabernacle.
NIV.13: The tent curtains will be a cubit longer on both sides; what is left will hang over the sides of the tabernacle so as to cover it.
NIV.14: Make for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of hides of sea cows.
NIV.15: “Make upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
NIV.16: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,
NIV.17: with two projections set parallel to each other. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
NIV.18: Make twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle
NIV.19: and make forty silver bases to go under them—two bases for each frame, one under each projection.
NIV.20: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, make twenty frames
NIV.21: and forty silver bases—two under each frame.
NIV.22: Make six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,
NIV.23: and make two frames for the corners at the far end.
NIV.24: At these two corners they must be double from the bottom all the way to the top, and fitted into a single ring; both shall be like that.
NIV.25: So there will be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
NIV.26: “Also make crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
NIV.27: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.
NIV.28: The center crossbar is to extend from end to end at the middle of the frames.
NIV.29: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.
NIV.30: “Set up the tabernacle according to the plan shown you on the mountain.
NIV.31: “Make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim worked into it by a skilled craftsman.
NIV.32: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.
NIV.33: Hang the curtain from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
NIV.34: Put the atonement cover on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place.
NIV.35: Place the table outside the curtain on the north side of the tabernacle and put the lampstand opposite it on the south side.
NIV.36: “For the entrance to the tent make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer.
NIV.37: Make gold hooks for this curtain and five posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold. And cast five bronze bases for them.

NRSVCE.27: and five bars for the frames of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the frames of the side of the tabernacle at the rear westward.
NRSVCE.28: The middle bar, halfway up the frames, shall pass through from end to end.
NRSVCE.29: You shall overlay the frames with gold, and shall make their rings of gold to hold the bars; and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
NRSVCE.30: Then you shall erect the tabernacle according to the plan for it that you were shown on the mountain.
NRSVCE.31: You shall make a curtain of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen; it shall be made with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
NRSVCE.32: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold, which have hooks of gold and rest on four bases of silver.
NRSVCE.33: You shall hang the curtain under the clasps, and bring the ark of the covenant in there, within the curtain; and the curtain shall separate for you the holy place from the most holy.
NRSVCE.34: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.
NRSVCE.35: You shall set the table outside the curtain, and the lampstand on the south side of the tabernacle opposite the table; and you shall put the table on the north side.
NRSVCE.36: You shall make a screen for the entrance of the tent, of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen, embroidered with needlework.
NRSVCE.37: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, and you shall cast five bases of bronze for them.

NET.1: “The tabernacle itself you are to make with ten curtains of fine twisted linen and blue and purple and scarlet; you are to make them with cherubim that are the work of an artistic designer.
NET.2: The length of each curtain is to be forty-two feet, and the width of each curtain is to be six feet — the same size for each of the curtains.
NET.3: Five curtains are to be joined, one to another, and the other five curtains are to be joined, one to another.
NET.4: You are to make loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and in the same way you are to make loops in the outer edge of the end curtain in the second set.
NET.5: You are to make fifty loops on the one curtain, and you are to make fifty loops on the end curtain which is on the second set, so that the loops are opposite one to another.
NET.6: You are to make fifty gold clasps and join the curtains together with the clasps, so that the tabernacle is a unit.
NET.7: “You are to make curtains of goats’ hair for a tent over the tabernacle; you are to make eleven curtains.
NET.8: The length of each curtain is to be forty-five feet, and the width of each curtain is to be six feet — the same size for the eleven curtains.
NET.9: You are to join five curtains by themselves and six curtains by themselves. You are to double over the sixth curtain at the front of the tent.
NET.10: You are to make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and fifty loops along the edge of the curtain that joins the second set.
NET.11: You are to make fifty bronze clasps and put the clasps into the loops and join the tent together so that it is a unit.
NET.12: Now the part that remains of the curtains of the tent — the half curtain that remains will hang over at the back of the tabernacle.
NET.13: The foot and a half on the one side and the foot and a half on the other side of what remains in the length of the curtains of the tent will hang over the sides of the tabernacle, on one side and the other side, to cover it.
NET.14: “You are to make a covering for the tent out of ram skins dyed red and over that a covering of fine leather.
NET.15: “You are to make the frames for the tabernacle out of acacia wood as uprights.
NET.16: Each frame is to be fifteen feet long, and each frame is to be two feet three inches wide,
NET.17: with two projections per frame parallel one to another. You are to make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
NET.18: So you are to make the frames for the tabernacle: twenty frames for the south side,
NET.19: and you are to make forty silver bases to go under the twenty frames — two bases under the first frame for its two projections, and likewise two bases under the next frame for its two projections;
NET.20: and for the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, twenty frames,
NET.21: and their forty silver bases, two bases under the first frame, and two bases under the next frame.
NET.22: And for the back of the tabernacle on the west you will make six frames.
NET.23: You are to make two frames for the corners of the tabernacle on the back.
NET.24: At the two corners they must be doubled at the lower end and finished together at the top in one ring. So it will be for both.
NET.25: So there are to be eight frames and their silver bases, sixteen bases, two bases under the first frame, and two bases under the next frame.
NET.26: “You are to make bars of acacia wood, five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
NET.27: and five bars for the frames on the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the frames on the back of the tabernacle on the west.
NET.28: The middle bar in the center of the frames will reach from end to end.
NET.29: You are to overlay the frames with gold and make their rings of gold to provide places for the bars, and you are to overlay the bars with gold.
NET.30: You are to set up the tabernacle according to the plan that you were shown on the mountain.
NET.31: “You are to make a special curtain of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen; it is to be made with cherubim, the work of an artistic designer.
NET.32: You are to hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold, set in four silver bases.
NET.33: You are to hang this curtain under the clasps and bring the ark of the testimony in there behind the curtain. The curtain will make a division for you between the Holy Place and the Most Holy Place.
NET.34: You are to put the atonement lid on the ark of the testimony in the Most Holy Place.
NET.35: You are to put the table outside the curtain and the lampstand on the south side of the tabernacle, opposite the table, and you are to place the table on the north side.
NET.36: “You are to make a hanging for the entrance of the tent of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer.
NET.37: You are to make for the hanging five posts of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, and their hooks will be gold, and you are to cast five bronze bases for them.

MSG.1: "Make The Dwelling itself from ten panels of tapestry woven from fine twisted linen, blue and purple and scarlet material, with an angel-cherubim design. A skilled craftsman should do it.
MSG.2: The panels of tapestry are each to be forty-six feet long and six feet wide.
MSG.3: Join five of the panels together, and then the other five together.
MSG.4: Make loops of blue along the edge of the outside panel of the first set and the same on the outside panel of the second set.
MSG.5: Make fifty loops on each panel.
MSG.6: Then make fifty gold clasps and join the tapestries together so that The Dwelling is one whole.
MSG.7: "Next make tapestries of goat hair for a tent that will cover The Dwelling. Make eleven panels of these tapestries.
MSG.8: The length of each panel will be forty-five feet long and six feet wide.
MSG.9: Join five of the panels together, and then the other six. Fold the sixth panel double at the front of the tent.
MSG.10: Now make fifty loops along the edge of the end panel and fifty loops along the edge of the joining panel.
MSG.11: Make fifty clasps of bronze and connect the clasps with the loops, bringing the tent together.
MSG.12: "Hang half of the overlap of the tapestry panels over the rear of The Dwelling.
MSG.13: The eighteen inches of overlap on either side will cover the sides of the tent.
MSG.14: Finally, make a covering for the tapestries of tanned rams' skins dyed red and over that a covering of dolphin skins.
MSG.15: "Frame The Dwelling with planks of acacia wood,
MSG.16: each section of frame fifteen feet long and two and one-quarter feet wide,
MSG.17: with two pegs for securing them. Make all the frames identical:
MSG.18: twenty frames for the south side
MSG.19: with forty silver sockets to receive the two pegs from each of the twenty frames;
MSG.20: the same construction on the north side of The Dwelling;
MSG.22: for the rear of The Dwelling, which faces west, make six frames
MSG.23: with two additional frames for the rear corners.
MSG.24: Both of the two corner frames need to be double in thickness from top to bottom and fit into a single ring—
MSG.25: eight frames altogether with sixteen sockets of silver, two under each frame.
MSG.26: "Now make crossbars of acacia wood, five for the frames on one side of The Dwelling,
MSG.27: five for the other side, and five for the back side facing west.
MSG.28: The center crossbar runs from end to end halfway up the frames.
MSG.29: Cover the frames with a veneer of gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. And cover the crossbars with a veneer of gold.
MSG.30: Then put The Dwelling together, following the design you were shown on the mountain.
MSG.31: "Make a curtain of blue, purple, and scarlet material and fine twisted linen. Have a design of angel-cherubim woven into it by a skilled craftsman.
MSG.32: Fasten it with gold hooks to four posts of acacia wood covered with a veneer of gold, set on four silver bases.
MSG.33: After hanging the curtain from the clasps, bring the Chest of The Testimony in behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Holy-of-Holies.
MSG.34: Now place the Atonement-Cover lid on the Chest of The Testimony in the Holy-of-Holies.
MSG.35: Place the Table and the Lampstand outside the curtain, the Lampstand on the south side of The Dwelling and the Table opposite it on the north side.
MSG.36: "Make a screen for the door of the tent. Weave it from blue, purple, and scarlet material and fine twisted linen.
MSG.37: Frame the weaving with five poles of acacia wood covered with a veneer of gold and make gold hooks to hang the weaving. Cast five bronze bases for the poles.
